finding.trigger: A type-invalid source is present during the core package build.
finding.observed: The installed TypeScript compiler reports TS2322 but emitSkipped is false with the original package options.
finding.expected: A failed core type check must not produce new build artifacts.

baseline.failed_case: does not emit build artifacts when a source has a type error

finding.correction: Enable noEmitOnError in the core package compiler configuration.

review.dependency_scope: Core/root/compiler/config task graph and representative actual loyalty account repository read; pagination reference candidates scanned across modules. No claim that all 108 pagination-reference module files or complete business modules were reviewed.

review.package_design: Private source-first package: main/types point to src/index.ts; build emits CommonJS JavaScript, consumers use source types. No distribution/declaration policy migration made. Root and core resolve installed TypeScript 5.9.3. The config devDependency is retained; the core compiler currently extends root tsconfig.base.json, not the config-package presets.
review.pagination: The shared interfaces are compile-time shapes, not runtime validators. Actual repository mapping tested for empty/unbounded, bounded first/final and beyond-total pages; generic item and required metadata contracts checked by compiler. No universal maximum/default/sort policy invented.

checks.build_runtime: Actual core source/config compiled using installed TypeScript API to a unique temporary directory; CommonJS entry loaded and exercised; temporary output removed.
checks.invalid_build: In-memory invalid source produces TS2322; emitSkipped true and zero write callbacks after correction. No invalid source or output written to repository.
